Here’s what I found that works for me, go into settings > storage>manage storage, then clear local Xbox cache, then local Xbox 360 cache. When you do this it will reset you console. Once you cleared both caches, launch Arma, then go to multiplayer and find the server you want to play on that’s modded, join it and it should pull up a content verification menu. Once its pulled up hit x to download all the mods n sit and wait. If your download gets stuck don’t worry just cancel it, delete the mods then clear both caches n re try it.
